title: STALKER 2 launches its first major expansion 'Cost of Hope' on August 20
summary: The DLC includes dozens of hours of additional content and a free update 2.0, confirmed by five specialized media outlets.

title: Malware in 'Meccha Chameleon' allows attackers to take control of players' PCs
summary: The Steam game fell victim to an attack through user maps and its Discord server was compromised; developers released security patches.

title: Xbox network suffers massive outage preventing playing digital and physical titles
summary: The failure, which lasted several hours, affected all online services of the console, similar to the PlayStation outage the previous week.

title: PlayStation players call for a week-long blackout in protest of the end of physical discs
summary: The initiative, which asks to turn off PS5s for a week, arises after rumors that Sony will remove the disc drive in its next console.

title: Cyan Worlds shows prototype of a canceled Myst sequel
summary: The project 'Project Anglerfish' never came to be but now its first images and details have been revealed.

title: Capcom confirms its goal of releasing a Resident Evil every year with remakes as a fundamental pillar
summary: The strategy will keep the franchise active while other titles like Pragmata are developed, according to Kotaku, PC Gamer and 3DJuegos.

title: PC performance of 'Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls' prompts official apologies from Arc System Works
summary: The open beta of the fighting game presented serious technical issues that affected PC players.

title: Halo remake leads sales in Japan and hides a secret ending about the future of the saga
summary: The remastered version of the classic reached first place on the Japanese weekly chart and contains a cryptic message.

title: Square Enix hints at the director of the next main Final Fantasy
summary: Media outlets like Polygon and Kotaku speculate on who will direct the new installment, while fans support the person behind FF7 Remake.

title: Square Enix considers expanding Final Fantasy remakes to four or five installments
summary: Gamespot and Eurogamer report that the company plans more ambitious versions of classic games, surpassing the FF7 trilogy.

title: Final Fantasy XIV will receive two major updates to its housing system
summary: The changes aim to bring the game on par with World of Warcraft, according to PC Gamer and Kite Kagi.

title: The actor from the Zelda movie breaks silence over his role and his experience with Breath of the Wild
summary: The actor playing Link shares his memories of playing the Nintendo title and talks about the challenges of filming.

title: Miyamoto thinks players are no longer interested in technical specifications of consoles
summary: The Nintendo creative believes that the gaming experience is now more important than hardware specs, according to Kotaku and Kite Kagi.
